build_transformer_temporal_aggregator: build a PyTorch Transformer encoder module to aggregate temporal features from shape (B, T, C) to (B, C')
create_mean_temporal_aggregator: create a Mean aggregation module that computes the temporal mean of (B, T, C) features across the time dimension
create_positional_encoding: create a sinusoidal PositionalEncoding module for transformer inputs with configurable dropout and maximum sequence length
build_rulstm_temporal_aggregator: build a RULSTM-based temporal aggregation module that aggregates (B, T, C) features with optional zero-padding on the time axis
create_identity_aggregator: create an Identity pass-through aggregation module that returns input features unchanged with an empty auxiliary losses dict
